# AI use: this file was originally generated by the MoveIt Setup Assistant and extended by the author. Claude
# (Anthropic; Claude Sonnet 5.5 via claude.ai), November 2026, added the comments and added
# scripts/Cartesian_Path_Planner.py to the programs that are installed, so that `ros2 run gungnir
# Cartesian_Path_Planner.py` works and the planner is part of the built package. Claude tested the install()
# commands with a plain CMake project (the ament lines replaced by nothing) but has NOT built the package with
# colcon or ROS 2.
# Reviewed and tested by: not yet reviewed or tested by the author.

# Oldest CMake version this file works with (Ubuntu 22.04 / ROS 2 Humble ships 3.22).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
# The package name; it must match <name> in package.xml. ${PROJECT_NAME} below expands to "gungnir".
project(gungnir)

# ament_cmake provides the ROS 2 install and export commands used below.
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# Copy these folders into <install>/share/gungnir, where `ros2 launch` and FindPackageShare("gungnir") look.
install(DIRECTORY launch config worlds DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
# Marks the package as made by the MoveIt Setup Assistant.
install(FILES .setup_assistant DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

# Install these scripts as runnable programs in <install>/lib/gungnir, where `ros2 run gungnir <name>` and the
# Node(package="gungnir", executable="<name>") entries of the launch files find them. PROGRAMS (unlike FILES)
# makes each copy executable, even when the source file is not. NOTE: with `colcon build --symlink-install` the
# installed entry is only a link to the source file, so the source file itself must be executable
# (chmod +x, and commit that change to git).
install(PROGRAMS
  # Straight-line (Cartesian) robot moves with MoveIt. Gungnir_Client_ROS2.py runs it after the user approves a
  # grasp; it can also be run by hand: ros2 run gungnir Cartesian_Path_Planner.py --help
  scripts/Cartesian_Path_Planner.py
  # Simulation: adapts the simulated camera's topics to the ones the client expects.
  scripts/sim_camera_adapter.py
  # Simulation: stands in for the gripper.
  scripts/sim_gripper_stub.py
  # Intel RealSense L515 camera node (real camera).
  scripts/l515_node.py
  # Live camera viewer.
  scripts/camera_viz.py
  # RViz markers for the simulated world.
  scripts/world_markers.py
  DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

# Must be the last command: it generates the files that make this a ROS 2 package.
ament_package()
